limits: Measurement-only on exact52;54 is parked and55 recipe profiling is complete. No speedup, quality, rate or simulation change.
One-in64 Main.Update attempts sampled independently for world, inventory and inventory_paused. Updates are NOT rendered Draw frames. Aggregate raw counts/ticks before division; unused means null.

Twenty original method envelopes plus original RunGame final flush. All original method signatures/access/call/RNG order remain unchanged. No per-tile, per-entity or per-predicate clocks; no skipped work or cache.

Inclusive scopes overlap. Exclusive subtracts only actual measured direct children in each dynamic call stack, not a global sum of other metric totals; includes observers and other unmeasured work. Worldgen exclusive is not pure random-tile-loop CPU.
Original Main.Update boundary snapshots cannot prove intermediate toggle-and-return, effective render camera/zoom, frozen simulation/NPC/weather state or arbitrary capture modes.

Player/camera/UI/hover/mouse/guide fields follow55 raw snapshots. Net mode, world width and height are raw Main.netMode/maxTilesX/maxTilesY. No getter such as WorldGen.GetWorldUpdateRate is called to observe simulation.
Scene ranges include every eligible Update boundary, not just selected samples. Guide/available-recipe/world context values are recorded, not additional admission or stability exclusions.
world excludes paused; inventory and inventory_paused separate. Menu/map/dead/ghost/spectator/invalid updates do not donate cost samples.

All original calls, returns, by-reference arguments, catch/finally behavior, RNG consumption and state mutation remain authoritative. Observer failure is sticky and never suppresses original work or donates partial timing.

no_body_samples means valid selected Main.Update scopes with zero recorded completed do_update scopes; it is not an invalid sample. Multiple or nested do_update calls are allowed by observer accounting.
Snapshot/clock-pair costs are indicators, not automatic deductions. Report body timing excludes footer cost; post-END failure follows the existing protected cooldown pattern.
Any measurement_invalid flag blocks performance interpretation. Malformed, mismatched, reordered, partial, inconsistent, duplicate or version55 packets are rejected, not repaired.
Reconcile observer updates with native update_total, not draw_total. Draw/s requires native counts and elapsed time, never1/update time or1/Draw time.
